name: Design Review Grid
tagline: A complete 35-slide design-review system with restrained serif section heads, fine rules, sage, orange and monochrome device studies.

palette.description: Measured public-preview colors; fine black/white rules and source-specific accents.

typography.style: Implemented fonts selected by preview matching; source font not verified. Inter 300/400 and Tinos Regular preserve the source sans-serif main voice and Times-like serif section titles. Font files are embedded offline; the exact files carry SIL OFL 1.1 notices saved alongside the template.

best_for: Structured product-design reviews connecting goals and user evidence to process, the precise feedback needed, current/proposed flows and alternate visual directions.
avoid_for: Dense board financial tables, decorative launch spectacles, and content that cannot fit the generous measured type hierarchy.

source_inspiration.name: Design Review — Figma Community
source_inspiration.notes: CC BY 4.0 Figma Community slide-deck template. Complete 35 public single-page previews reconstructed in original order; native text/rules/diagrams and independent media. Original fictional example copy and SVG product screens replace generic placeholders. Local navigation replaces the Figma player. Implemented fonts selected by preview matching; source font not verified. Inter 300/400 and Tinos Regular preserve the source sans-serif main voice and Times-like serif section titles. Font files are embedded offline; the exact files carry SIL OFL 1.1 notices saved alongside the template. See SOURCE-NOTICES.md for photography and interactive-component boundaries.
